title: Entropy production under coarse-graining limits: Stationary preservation and nonstationary convergence
summary: In this paper, we examine the preservation and loss of entropy production under coarse-graining limits of singularly perturbed diffusion semigroups. Under the coefficient convergence assumptions, we establish the lower semicontinuity of the stationary rate $σ_{\rm ss}$ and provide a necessary and sufficient condition for its convergence in terms of the weighted $L^2$ approximation.
